headline: PAM Jaya Targets IPO in 2027, Begins Sounding Out Chinese Investors
summary: The Jakarta provincial government is preparing an IPO of PAM Jaya on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, with Mandiri Sekuritas involved. It is also sounding out investors from China, targeting next year.
why: PAM Jaya is Jakarta's regional water utility, and a listing would make it one of the few public-sector utilities offered to private investors in Indonesia.
original_headline: PAM Jaya Target IPO 2027, Mulai Jajaki Investor Asal China
